description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIDefinition, which extends HTMLPurifier_Definition, and manages URI filtering and setup within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes filter registration, setup, and filtering methods, along with properties related to URI handling such as base, host, and default scheme.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIDefinition
classes.description: A class responsible for URI definition and filtering within the HTMLPurifier library, managing URI filters, base URI, host, and default scheme.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that registers default URI filters upon initialization.

methods.name: registerFilter
methods.description: Registers a filter in the URI definition's registry of filters.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to either the postFilters or filters array based on whether it is a post-filter.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Performs setup using the provided configuration, initializing member variables and filters.

methods.name: setupFilters
methods.description: Sets up filters based on the registered filters and configuration.

methods.name: setupMemberVariables
methods.description: Initializes URI base, host, and default scheme from the configuration.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies all registered filters to a given URI.

methods.name: postFilter
methods.description: Applies all registered post-filters to a given URI.
